item.title: 8 Funniest ‘Far Side’ Comics About Fruits and Vegetables
item.description: Decades after Gary Larson concluded his comic strip The Far Side back in 1995, fans of the series continue to read it regularly, and new fans are discovering it all the time. Some of Larson’s most beloved comic strips feature animals drawn in his signature style, including dogs, chickens, and especially cows . He often gave these animals human-like intelligence and other anthropomorphic traits and depicted them in very human-like scenarios.

item.title: Star Trek: Voyager Officially Revisits the Series' Best Two-Parter in a Brand-New Way
item.description: One of the best two-episode arcs in Star Trek: Voyager , if not the entire Star Trek franchise, is the "Year of Hell" duology. The story from the show's fourth season pitted the crew of Voyager against a unique threat that tested their perseverance more than any previous enemy had.

item.title: GTA: Boston Would Go Wicked Hard, Kid
item.description: Considering that Grand Theft Auto 6 just launched after a 13-year wait, it’s safe to say that we won’t be getting another one any time soon. That’s fine, because Leonida is so enormous that I know I’ll still be finding secrets in it years from now. And yet, I can’t help myself. I’m already wondering where the series could possibly go next. Allow me to offer one unsolicited idea: Massachusetts.

item.title: The Sims 4 Officially Makes 13 DLCs Free for a Limited Time
item.description: The Sims 4 has received a steady stream of content since it launched 12 years ago. However, 2026 has been particularly dry. The last major expansion, Royalty & Legacy , was released in February, and aside from kits, the game hasn't received much content this year. This may be because of the team's focus on Project Renee (which may be on hold) or because of internal matters related to Electronic Arts' private-equity buyout .

item.title: 32 Years Later, Disney's Most Notorious Cash-Grab Sequel Is Better Than You Remember
item.description: Ever since former Disney CEO Bob Chapek released his autobiography last September, a rather unexpected Disney movie has been a topic for discussion: the direct-to-VHS sequel to Aladdin titled The Return of Jafar . Released in 1994, The Return of Jafar was the first in a long line of direct-to-VHS (and later direct-to-DVD) sequels to theatrical Disney films. Besides Aladdin , Disney made sequels to The Lion King , The Little Mermaid , Pocahontas , Mulan , and several other then-modern Disney animated features, as well as some much older classics like Cinderella and Bambi . These movies used cheaper animation produced by Disney’s TV division and were developed in far less time than Disney spends developing animated feature films .

item.title: 7 Years Later, Hollywood’s Most Notorious Fantasy Flop Deserves Another Shot
item.description: I vividly remember learning the phrase “uncanny valley” in 2019. First came the trailer for Sonic the Hedgehog that April, with those alarmingly human teeth. Then came the first trailer for Tom Hooper’s Cats in July. Suddenly, there was a name for a feeling I’d had my whole life. The uncanny valley is that uneasy feeling you get when something looks or moves almost like a real person, but some small detail makes the whole thing feel wrong. That feeling is a lot more common these days, now that AI-generated videos are everywhere. But it was Cats that really brought the uncanny valley into the popular lexicon.

item.title: The 14 Best Star Wars Games of All Time, Ranked
item.description: Star Wars video games date all the way back to The Empire Strikes Back on the Atari 2600 in 1982. Since then, the franchise itself has largely matured alongside the medium, encompassing everything from role-playing games and first-person shooters to arcade racers and XCOM clones (the latter of two seeing well-regard releases just this year). No matter the year or the hardware, some of the best Star Wars games are worth revisiting. Here are the 12 best Star Wars games of all time, ranked.

item.title: Sorry Jason And Lucia, These 5 GTA 6 Side Characters Steal Every Scene They're In
item.description: Although Jason and Lucia are the stars of Grand Theft Auto 6 and amazing characters in their own right, there are lots of side characters who steal the show whenever they show up. From folks critical to the main story path to weirdos you meet if you take the time to stop and chat with someone on the side of the road, GTA 6 constantly introduces wild, memorable characters almost every hour.

item.title: GTA 6 Developers Have Voted Against Unionization by 75% to 25%
item.description: Rockstar Games' UK workforce has voted firmly against unionization the week after the studio's latest game, Grand Theft Auto 6 , demolished sales records .

item.title: Spring Tokyo City region treasure hunt location in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: The spring Tokyo City region treasure hunt is one of the weekly activities in Forza Horizon 6 Series 7, "City Life." Whenever a new hunt begins, a box appears somewhere on the map and, to locate it, the only hints you have are the region's name and a picture. Completing this challenge helps you get closer to claiming the weekly and the Series cars.
